Name: Luny's Cuter Companions Recolor
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
Just started getting trinkets in my game, at long last! Which means... new recolor! ⸜(*ˊᗜˋ*)⸝

I LOVE the little frogs! They're so cute! And what would be even cuter? A pink bow on their heads! ♡ This also recolors the frogs, fairies, butterflies, and parrot to be more pastel. The parrot is based on some pink tropical parrots I found via google searches.

The void frog has also been adjusted to have the same cute shape as the other frogs, but still has it's bright red eyes.


[b]To install:[/b]
Unzip the file and drop the folder [CP] Luny's Cuter Companions Recolor into your StardewValley/mods folder. Requires Content Patcher and Smapi!

Manifest.Description: Recolors the trinket companions to be more pastel, and adds a cute bow to the frogs
